relationships.subject: vixotrigine
relationships.evidence_quote: we find that vixotrigine potently inhibits sodium currents produced by both peripheral and central nervous system Nav subtypes

key_findings: Vixotrigine is a broad-spectrum, state-dependent (use- and voltage-dependent) Nav blocker, IC50 1.76-5.12 uM.
Vixotrigine prolongs recovery from fast inactivation and shifts steady-state inactivation in DRG sodium channels.
